# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Top Bar**: A system-level header bar is visible at the very top of the screen.
  - Left side: "Activities" label.
  - Center: "LibreOffice Writer" application title.
  - Right side: System status icons including date and time ("Oct 23 00:38"), notification bell, and system controls (minimize, maximize, close).

## Application Window

- **Window Title**: "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Writer" is displayed at the top of the application window.
- **Window Controls**: Standard window controls (minimize, maximize, close) are located in the top-right corner of the application window.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Bar**: A horizontal menu bar is positioned directly below the window title.
  - Menu items from left to right: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Form, Tools, Window, Help.

## Toolbar

- **Toolbar**: A toolbar is located below the menu bar, containing various icons for common functions.
  - Icons include: New document, Open, Save, Save As, Print, Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, Find, Replace, Font color, Character formatting, Paragraph style dropdown, and more.
  - A dropdown menu labeled "Default Paragraph Style" is visible.

## File Open Dialog

- **Dialog Title**: "Open" is displayed at the top center of the dialog.
- **Dialog Buttons**: 
  - Left: "Cancel" button.
  - Right: "Open" button.
  - Search icon (magnifying glass) is positioned to the left of the "Open" button.
- **Navigation Pane** (Left Side):
  - "Recent" (with clock icon)
  - "Home" (with house icon)
  - "Desktop" (with desktop icon)
  - "Documents" (with document icon, highlighted in orange)
  - "Downloads" (with down arrow icon)
  - "Music" (with music note icon)
  - "Pictures" (with image icon)
  - "Videos" (with video camera icon)
  - "Trash" (with trash can icon)
  - "Other Locations" (with plus sign icon)
- **Path Bar** (Top Center):
  - Navigation path: "<" (back button), "user" (home directory), "Documents" (current directory), ">" (forward button).
- **File List Area** (Center):
  - Empty file list area with column headers: "Name", "Size", "Type", "Modified".
  - No files are currently displayed.
- **File Filter** (Bottom Right):
  - Dropdown menu labeled "All files" with a downward arrow.
- **Version and Read-Only Options** (Bottom Left):
  - "Version:" label with a dropdown arrow.
  - "Read-only" checkbox (unchecked).

## Sidebar (Right Side)

- **Sidebar Panel**:
  - Contains buttons for quick access to features.
  - "Get involved" button with an "X" icon.
  - "Donate" button with an "X" icon.
  - Vertical menu icon (three horizontal lines).
- **Vertical Scroll Bar**:
  - Located on the far right edge of the sidebar panel.
  - Scroll bar thumb and arrows are visible.

## Left Sidebar (Application Dock)

- **Application Dock**:
  - Contains application icons arranged vertically.
  - Icons include: Google Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer (highlighted), LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files (file manager), Ubuntu Software, Help, and Trash.
  - A grid icon (app drawer) is located at the bottom of the dock.

## Status Bar

- **Status Bar** (Bottom of the application window):
  - Left side: "Page 1 of 1" (page number indicator).
  - Center: "0 words, 0 characters" (word and character count).
  - Middle: "Default Page Style" (page style indicator).
  - Right side: "English (Hong Kong)" (language setting).
  - Zoom controls: "100%" (zoom level), plus and minus buttons for zoom adjustment.
  - Page layout icons: three icons for page layout options.
  - Page number indicator: "1" (current page number).

## Additional UI Elements

- **Information Messages**:
  - Two blue information banners are visible below the toolbar.
  - First banner: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!".
  - Second banner: "Your donations support our worldwide community.".
- **Document Area**:
  - The main document editing area is visible behind the file dialog.
  - The document is titled "Untitled 1".
  - The document area is empty, with a cursor visible at the beginning of the document.
- **Document Properties**
